lines.text: Five in the morning, before the cockerel,
She's on the road with a yellow can.
Red dust, bare feet, an hour each way,
And it's heavier coming home.
She's seven. Same as my eldest.
The water's brown. She drinks it anyway.
Her brother coughs all night.
She walks the long way round the school
And doesn't go in.
Seven in the morning, green and pleasant land,
The boiler hums, the tap runs hot,
My boys are fighting over cereal
And I'm moaning that the Wi-Fi's slow.
Two pairs of school shoes by the door,
Two lunchboxes, two coats, two futures,
And her face came up on my phone again,
And I scrolled on by.
Once, I said I'd do it later.
Twice, I said what difference can one man make.
Three times I scrolled on by,
And somewhere a cockerel cried.
Holy, holy,
Wake me from my sleep.
Every face that I scrolled past
Was You, looking at me.
Will you sponsor me?
With the help of God, I will.
Will you sponsor me?
With the help of God, I will.
A pound a day. A pound a day.
Less than the coffee going cold beside me.
It doesn't go in her pocket, it goes in the ground:
A well, a nurse, a classroom roof,
And four more children drinking there beside her.
My son drew her a lion in felt-tip,
Folded it into a padded envelope
With stickers and a pack of crayons,
And twelve weeks later, through the letterbox:
A house, a blue door, and a sun with a face.
Dear friend. I am well. The water is clean now.
I go to school. I am learning to write.
I drew you my tree.
Holy, holy,
Wake me from my sleep.
Every face that I scrolled past
Was You, looking at me.
Will you sponsor me?
With the help of God, I will.
Will you sponsor me?
With the help of God, I will.
You don't have to sing my song
To know that this is wrong.
You don't need my God to see a child
Who's been waiting forty days.
But I see a table long as the sky,
Laid on a mountain in the light,
Every nation, every tribe and tongue,
No colour, no border, no first, no last,
And a chair beside her with your name on.
Let the little children come.
Let the little children come.
Whoever welcomes one of these
Welcomes Me.
Holy, holy,
Wake us from our sleep.
Every face that we scrolled past
Was You, looking at us.
Will you sponsor me?
With the help of God, we will.
Will you sponsor me?
With the help of God, we will.
We will.
We will.
We will.
We will.
Five in the morning, and the cockerel crows.
She's on the road with a reading book.
The yellow can is full beside the door,
And she's running.
I will.
I will.

notes: Timeline = the take's master WAV. Method (pdoom-video's, MIT): CTC emissions of the Demucs (htdemucs_ft) vocal stem from torchaudio MMS_FA and wav2vec2-large-lv60k-960h, on the mono sum and the left and right channels, fused; one global constrained Viterbi alignment of every line with a garbage star token between lines (the singer's ad-lib repeats); signal refinement of starts and ends on the vocal stem; cross-check against mlx-whisper; QA plots per line.
